description: Built-in builder tools module providing WorldEdit-like block editing, prefab editing, scripted brushes, OBJ/image import, and clipboard/undo-redo infrastructure for creative-mode world building.

systems: BuilderToolsSystems.EnsureBuilderTools (EntityStore HolderSystem - ensures builder tools in player inventory on join)
BuilderToolsUserDataSystem (EntityStore HolderSystem - ensures BuilderToolsUserData component on players)

commands.description: 38 commands registered in commands/ subpackage. All extend AbstractPlayerCommand and are Creative-mode gated.

selectionCommands.name: ExpandCommand
selectionCommands.desc: Expand selection by distance in axis/look direction

selectionCommands.name: SelectionHistoryCommand
selectionCommands.desc: Toggle selection history recording in undo/redo

editCommands.name: SetCommand
editCommands.desc: Set all blocks in selection to a pattern

editCommands.name: ReplaceCommand
editCommands.desc: Replace blocks, supports regex and substring swap

editCommands.name: ClearBlocksCommand
editCommands.desc: Clear all blocks in selection or by coordinates

editCommands.name: TintCommand
editCommands.desc: Set tint color on blocks in selection

editCommands.name: EditLineCommand
editCommands.desc: Draw a line between two points

editCommands.name: GlobalMaskCommand
editCommands.desc: Set/clear global mask for all operations

clipboardCommands.name: CutCommand
clipboardCommands.desc: Cut selection to clipboard (copy + clear original)

clipboardCommands.name: PasteCommand
clipboardCommands.desc: Paste clipboard at player position or coordinates. Flag: --technical

clipboardCommands.name: RotateCommand
clipboardCommands.desc: Rotate clipboard by angle around axis, supports arbitrary yaw/pitch/roll

clipboardCommands.name: FlipCommand
clipboardCommands.desc: Flip/mirror clipboard along axis based on look direction

clipboardCommands.name: StackCommand
clipboardCommands.desc: Stack selection in a direction. Flags: --empty, --spacing

importCommands.name: ImageImportCommand
importCommands.desc: Import image as blocks using color matching

prefabEditorCommands.name: PrefabEditCommand
prefabEditorCommands.desc: Root command for prefab editing session management, delegates to subcommands

prefabEditorCommands.name: PrefabEditLoadCommand
prefabEditorCommands.desc: Load existing prefab(s) into editing session

prefabEditorCommands.name: PrefabEditSaveAsCommand
prefabEditorCommands.desc: Save prefab under a new path

prefabEditorCommands.name: PrefabEditExitCommand
prefabEditorCommands.desc: Exit prefab editing session and return to source world

prefabEditorCommands.name: PrefabEditInfoCommand
prefabEditorCommands.desc: Show info about current prefab edit session

prefabEditorCommands.name: PrefabEditKillEntitiesCommand
prefabEditorCommands.desc: Kill entities in prefab edit session

prefabEditorCommands.name: PrefabEditSelectCommand
prefabEditorCommands.desc: Select a loaded prefab in session

scriptedBrushCommands.name: BrushConfigCommand
scriptedBrushCommands.desc: Root command for scripted brush configuration

scriptedBrushCommands.name: BrushConfigDebugStepCommand
scriptedBrushCommands.desc: Step through brush config in debug mode

scriptedBrushCommands.name: BrushConfigLoadCommand
scriptedBrushCommands.desc: Load a scripted brush asset by name

toolOperations.description: Real-time brush tool operations executed via BuilderToolOnUseInteraction packet. Each tool is registered in ToolOperation.OPERATIONS map.

Paint.desc: Place blocks using brush shape. Tracks painted positions to avoid re-painting on hold.

Sculpt.desc: Add/remove blocks at surface edges. Alt-key smooths. Primary removes exposed blocks, secondary fills adjacent-to-block air.

Flood.desc: Flood fill within shape bounds from click position.

Smooth.desc: Smooth terrain using weighted 3x3x3 kernel (SMOOTHING_KERNEL). Replaces minority blocks with majority neighbors.

Tint.desc: Apply tint color to ground columns.

LaserPointer.desc: Laser pointer tool for precise targeting.

brushFeatures: Rotation transform (auto from look direction or explicit axis/angle)
Mirror transform (auto from look direction or explicit axis)
Block mask (target, above, below, adjacent, neighbor filters; invertible)
Hold-down interpolation (calculates intermediate positions between frames)

transforms.Transform: Interface with apply(Vector3i). NONE identity. Composable via then().

selectionSystem.description: Region selection and editing managed through BuilderToolsPlugin.BuilderState, one per player UUID.

builderState.taskQueue: Operations queued via addToQueue(), executed sequentially on world thread via CompletableFuture.runAsync(this::runTask, world)

snapshots.BlockSelectionSnapshot: Stores before/after block state via BlockSelection
snapshots.ClipboardSnapshot: Interface extending SelectionSnapshot for clipboard-aware restore
snapshots.EntityAddSnapshot: Snapshot that adds an entity on restore
snapshots.EntityRemoveSnapshot: Snapshot that removes an entity on restore
snapshots.EntityTransformSnapshot: Snapshot of entity transform for restore

undoRedoSystem.historyManagement: FIFO queues with configurable max size (historyCount). StampedLock protects concurrent access.

editOperation.desc: Tracks before/after BlockSelection for a brush operation. Uses OverridableChunkAccessor for world block access with mask filtering.

clipboardSystem.description: Copy/paste uses BlockSelection objects. CopyCutSettings bitflags control what is included.
clipboardFeatures: Copy/cut selection with optional entity inclusion
Paste at arbitrary coordinates or player position
Clipboard rotation (axis + angle, or arbitrary yaw/pitch/roll)
Transform-then-paste (rotation + translation applied to clipboard data)
Clipboard includes blocks, fluids, entities, and anchors
KeepEmptyBlocks toggle for selection tool paste mode

transformationMode.desc: Per-player settings for selection transform mode. Stores clipboard block changes, fluid changes, entity changes, and offset origin for transform paste.

scriptedBrushSystem.description: Data-driven brush system allowing JSON-defined brush operation sequences. Loaded from ScriptedBrushAsset or via command-based configuration.

components.BrushConfig: Runtime state for a scripted brush execution: origin, shape, dimensions, pattern, density, masks (brush, operation, history), thickness, capped
components.BrushConfigCommandExecutor: Executes sequential brush operations. Manages operation index, debug stepping, persistent variables, saved snapshots, and stored indexes for jump operations.
components.BrushConfigEditStore: Edit store for scripted brushes. Tracks before/previous/current BlockSelection layers. Flushes between operation iterations.
components.BrushConfigChunkAccessor: Custom chunk accessor that overlays edit history on world data for scripted brush block reads.
components.ScriptedBrushAsset: JSON asset defining a list of BrushOperations. Loaded from 'ScriptedBrushes' asset path.

system.BrushOperation: Abstract base. Has OPERATION_CODEC (CodecMapCodec) and BRUSH_OPERATION_REGISTRY.
system.GlobalBrushOperation: Applied once before sequential execution begins.
system.SequenceBrushOperation: Executed in sequence. Can modify brush config and optionally operate on blocks.

globalOperations.desc: Ignore existing brush data from tool args

blockModifying.desc: Paste a prefab at brush origin

flowControl.desc: Conditional jump on block type at position
Conditional jump on tool arg value

loops.desc: Load loop count from tool arg

saveAndLoad.desc: Save brush config snapshot by name
Save current operation index by name
Get/set persistent variables across brush executions

ui.ScriptedBrushPage: UI page for scripted brush configuration

prefabEditorSystem.description: Full prefab editing workflow: creates isolated worlds for editing prefab files, with load, edit, save, and exit lifecycle.

manager.desc: Manages active prefab edit sessions. Creates temporary worlds per editor, handles loading/pasting prefabs, teleportation, and cleanup.
features: Loads one or multiple prefabs into editing world with configurable layout (stacking axis, alignment, row splitting, spacing)
Supports Flat or Void world gen for editing environment
Exit session returns player to source world and deletes editing world
Tracks which prefabs are being edited to prevent concurrent edits

session.desc: Serializable session state. Stored as EntityStore resource, persisted/restored via codec on world save/load.

metadata.desc: Per-loaded-prefab metadata: path, bounding box (min/max), anchor position, paste position, dirty flag

enums.PrefabStackingAxis: X, Z axis for laying out multiple prefabs
enums.WorldGenType: FLAT, VOID for editing world terrain

saving.PrefabSaver: Handles saving prefab data from editing world back to file

ui.PrefabEditorExitConfirmPage: Confirmation dialog before exiting unsaved session
ui.PrefabEditorLoadSettingsPage: UI for configuring prefab load settings
ui.PrefabEditorSaveSettingsPage: UI for configuring prefab save settings
ui.PrefabTeleportPage: UI for teleporting between loaded prefabs

interactions.PrefabSelectionInteraction: Block interaction for selecting prefabs in editing world
interactions.PrefabSetAnchorInteraction: Block interaction for setting prefab anchor point

dirtySystems.PrefabDirtySystems.BlockBreakDirtySystem: Marks prefab as dirty when blocks are broken
dirtySystems.PrefabDirtySystems.BlockPlaceDirtySystem: Marks prefab as dirty when blocks are placed

prefabListSystem.description: UI for browsing and managing prefab files.

classes.name: AssetPrefabFileProvider
classes.desc: Provides prefab file listing from asset directories

classes.name: PrefabPage
classes.desc: UI page for browsing prefab list

classes.name: PrefabSavePage
classes.desc: UI page for saving prefabs from clipboard

imageImportSystem.description: Import images as block art using color matching.

classes.name: ImageImportCommand
classes.desc: Command to import an image file as blocks

classes.name: ImageImportPage
classes.desc: UI page for image import settings

colorMatching.desc: Maps blocks to colors using CIE Lab color space. Builds index from all solid cube blocks with particle colors. Provides findClosestBlock(r,g,b), findDarkerVariant, findBlockForLerpedColor.

classes.name: ObjImportPage
classes.desc: UI page for OBJ import settings

classes.name: ObjParser
classes.desc: Parses Wavefront .obj file format (vertices, faces, UVs, normals)

classes.name: MeshVoxelizer
classes.desc: Converts triangle mesh to voxel grid

classes.name: TextureSampler
classes.desc: Samples texture colors for voxelization color mapping

protocolIntegration.description: BuilderToolsPacketHandler registers 20+ packet handlers for client-server communication.

packetHandler.permission: hytale.editor.builderTools (base), with sub-permissions for specific features

askForClipboard.desc: Request clipboard data for client-side preview

serverToClient: BuilderToolSelectionToolReplyWithClipboard (sends block + fluid clipboard data to client)
EditorBlocksChange (sends block changes for selection visualization)

systems.desc: On player entity add, populates tools inventory from BuilderToolItemReferenceAsset registry.
Ensures BuilderToolsUserData component on players that don't have it.
WorldEventSystem handling PrefabPasteEvent. Manages pastedPrefabPathUUIDMap cleanup.
Marks prefab as dirty on block break in editing world.
Marks prefab as dirty on block place in editing world.

components.name: BuilderToolsUserData
components.desc: Per-player setting: selectionHistory boolean controlling undo recording of selection changes.

components.name: PrefabAnchor
components.desc: Marks entities as prefab anchor points.

resources.name: PrefabEditSession
resources.desc: World-level resource storing active prefab editing session state. Serialized via codec.

blockTypes.BlockType: Used extensively for block ID lookup, draw type checking (Cube/CubeWithModel), particle color for color index
blockTypes.BlockPattern: Pattern for multi-block placement (weighted random). Used by set, fill, replace, line, brush operations.
blockTypes.BlockMask: Filtering predicate for operations. Combines target, above, below, adjacent, neighbor filters.
blockTypes.BlockState/BlockStateModule: Block state creation when copying blocks with state data

worldAccess.World: Primary world reference for chunk access, entity store, notification handler, world map
worldAccess.ChunkStore/EntityStore: ECS stores for chunk and entity data
worldAccess.LocalCachedChunkAccessor: Cached chunk accessor for efficient multi-chunk brush operations
worldAccess.OverridableChunkAccessor: Accessor that can overlay modifications (used by EditOperation)
worldAccess.WorldChunk/BlockSection/FluidSection: Low-level chunk data access for block/fluid reads and tint writes

prefabSystem.PrefabUtil: Utility for pasting prefab buffers into world
prefabSystem.PrefabPasteEvent: Event fired on prefab paste start/end

assetTypes: BuilderTool (builder tool definition with args and brush config)
BrushData / BrushData.Values (brush shape, size, material, mask settings)
Environment / WeatherForecast (for prefab editor world setup)

commandSystem.CommandManager: Used for executing commands from brush operations (RunCommandOperation, NPC commands)
commandSystem.AbstractPlayerCommand: Base class for player-targeted commands with GameMode and permission gating

mathUtilities: BlockCubeUtil, BlockSphereUtil, BlockCylinderUtil, BlockConeUtil, BlockPyramidUtil, BlockDomeUtil, BlockInvertedDomeUtil, BlockDiamondUtil, BlockTorusUtil (shape iteration)

utils.Material: Value type representing block (id+rotation), fluid (id+level), or empty. Factory methods: block(), fluid(), fromKey(), fromPattern().
utils.FluidPatternHelper: Resolves fluid names to FluidInfo (fluidId, fluidLevel) for pattern parsing.
utils.RecursivePrefabLoader: Recursively loads prefabs including child prefabs.

interactions.PickupItemInteraction: Block interaction type allowing items to be picked up. Registered with id '*PickupItem'. Has DEFAULT_ROOT root interaction.
